text: I am writing to respectfully request the placement of a temporary second school crossing guard at the intersection of Kingston Road and McCowan Road/Cathedral Bluffs Drive. The school parent community has continued to raise serious concerns about safety at this intersection. The location is immediately adjacent to a major six-lane section of Kingston Road, with high vehicle speeds, complex turning movements, and challenging sightlines. Parents and school staff report that driver behaviour, including aggressive driving and failure to yield, further increases the risk for children and families walking to and from school. Given these ongoing concerns, and in light of the unique design and operating conditions at this intersection, I am requesting that Scarborough Community Council override the technical analysis and authorize the placement of a temporary second school crossing guard at…

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services, to install a second temporary school crossing guard at the intersection of Kingston Road and McCowan Road / Cathedral Bluffs Drive, until a subsequent warrant analysis can be conducted by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.
